items: Because the renovation is nearly complete, ____ contractors remain on site this week.
'Contractors' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
The revised checklist leaves ____ room for confusion about the inspection procedure.
'Room' is uncountable in the sense of opportunity or scope, so 'little' is correct.
The hiring manager scheduled ____ short interviews before making the final selection.
'Interviews' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
The design team needs ____ more time to test the layout on older devices.
'Time' is uncountable, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
Very ____ invoices are still processed manually after the accounting upgrade.
'Invoices' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct after 'Very'.
The supplier provided ____ information about the cause of the production delay.
We have ____ sample units available for customers who want an in-store demonstration.
'Sample units' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
Adding ____ cushioning inside the package should keep the glassware from shifting.
'Cushioning' is uncountable here, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
Only ____ seats remain for Thursday's compliance seminar.
'Seats' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct after 'Only'.
The branch has ____ flexibility to change the delivery window once the truck is dispatched.
The auditor requested ____ additional receipts before closing the review.
'Receipts' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
Please allow ____ extra space between the display cases to improve customer flow.
'Space' is uncountable here, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
____ managers approved the proposal without requesting a revised cost estimate.
'Managers' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
The automated packaging line requires ____ supervision once operators complete the initial training.
The event coordinator kept ____ name badges blank for late registrants.
'Name badges' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
A technician applied ____ lubricant to the hinge before testing the cabinet door again.
'Lubricant' is uncountable here, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
The downtown office receives ____ walk-in visitors on Friday afternoons.
'Walk-in visitors' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
There is ____ demand for overnight shipping on this route during the off-season.
'Demand' is uncountable here, so 'little' is correct.
The maintenance crew found ____ loose connections during the routine equipment check.
'Loose connections' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
The purchasing team has ____ negotiating room because the annual order is unusually large.
'Negotiating room' is uncountable, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
____ customers noticed the change to the receipt format after the software update.
'Customers' is countable plural, so 'few' is correct.
The draft budget allows ____ spending on nonessential travel this quarter.
The receptionist printed ____ extra visitor passes for guests who had not preregistered.
'Visitor passes' is countable plural, and 'a few' expresses a small positive number.
We need ____ feedback from the legal team before publishing the revised policy.
'Feedback' is uncountable, and 'a little' expresses a small positive amount.
____ of the submitted designs met all three accessibility requirements.
'Designs' is countable plural, so 'Few' is correct.
